description: This file defines the FavoritesController class within an ASP.NET Core web application. The controller manages endpoints for favoriting and unfavoriting articles, utilizing MediatR for command handling and applying authorization mechanisms.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling article favorites, with endpoints to add or remove favorites.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST request to add an article to favorites based on the article's slug.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove an article from favorites based on the article's slug.
